dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I'm so happy! And all the grandmas and grandpas in Qingce Village had a great time, too.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: You mean... what am I doing here? Well, just now, I did a performance for everyone!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Although I can't play an instrument anywhere near as well as Master, I can still sing.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Even Granny Ruoxin said I did a great job. She also gave me some candies, hee-hee!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Master's told me a lot of stories about the adepti!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: There was Skybracer with the giant deer horns, and Sea Gazer who loved to collect treasure...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Sometimes, Master talks and talks for a long time, until her voice starts to sound sad. But then she always breaks into a smile again, and tells me all of the things each of them loved best about Liyue...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Some of the adepti are gone now, but it's okay, because I'm gonna help take care of everyone in their stead!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I'm happy that Mr. Dvorak found the fairy lady from his story. And I'm also happy that it turned out it was Master all along.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Also, I helped out this time too, didn't I? So that means I was... paying "ho-ma-ge" to my master?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Oh, oh, also, Mr. Dvorak got one of his friends to bring me a toy from Fontaine! I like it a lot!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: At first... I didn't know whether I was supposed to accept it or not... But then Master said it was okay, so I did!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: See you! Make sure you take good care of Paimon!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Oh, and please come play with me if you ever have the time!
